blocks.html: A product option to create or update.

types.name: id
types.description:
The ID of the product option to update. If not provided, the product
option is created. In that case, the `title` and `values` properties are
required.

types.name: ranks
types.description: The rank for each option value. The key is the option value, and the value is the rank.

types.name: is_exclusive
types.description: Whether the product option is exclusive to a product or shared across products.

types.name: metadata
types.description: The metadata of the product option.
